observations.behavior: Adds a nullable BIGINT column max_version to person_pg_cleanup_queue and records the highest ClickHouse person version removed by the sweep.
observations.code_quote: ALTER TABLE person_pg_cleanup_queue ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_version BIGINT;
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Postgres cleanup drain to check the stored version against the ClickHouse version before deleting a Postgres person, preventing deletion of persons newer than the last successful sweep. This could preserve data consistency and avoid deleting recently promoted persons if the sweep failed or was incomplete.
